title: Neural Rosette Formation and Selection
author: Celeste M M. Karch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x86frze

steps.title: Wash Neural Spheres
steps.instruction: On Day 5 of neural aggregate formation, wash the spheres to remove media.

substeps.instruction: Remove media by pipetting.
Carefully wash spheres 2 times with 100 µL of pre-warmed DMEM/F12, ensuring spheres are not broken apart.
Alternative method: Remove 50 µL of spent media and wash with 50 µL DMEM/F12.

steps.title: Transfer Spheres to Coated Wells
steps.instruction: Transfer the neural spheres into PLO/laminin-coated wells.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL of fresh neural induction media to the spheres.
Aspirate laminin from one well of the pre-coated plate.
Using 200 μl sterile tips, carefully pipet up spheres using 100 µL volume and transfer 32 spheres per well.
Repeat for remaining wells.
Distribute cells evenly by making a 'T' motion.

steps.title: Incubate and Maintain Aggregates
steps.instruction: Incubate cells and maintain media to ensure attachment.

substeps.instruction: Incubate cells in a 37 °C, 5% CO2, and 95% humidified chamber.
After 24 hours, examine attached aggregates.
Remove medium and replace with 2 mL/well fresh neural induction medium daily.
For aggregates that have not attached, replace medium with 1 mL/well fresh neural induction medium.
Once 90-100% of aggregates attach, continue daily exchange with 2 mL/well neural induction medium.

steps.title: Monitor for Rosette Formation
steps.instruction: Observe spheres daily under a microscope for the formation of neural rosette structures.

substeps.instruction: Harvest when spheres have completely flattened and clusters are clearly visible (typically 3-7 days after plating, depending on the line).

steps.title: Harvest Neural Rosettes
steps.instruction: Remove unattached cells and select for neural rosettes.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate spent medium.
Add 1 mL of pre-warmed DMEM/F12 to each well to remove unattached cells (repeat if necessary).
Add 1 mL of Neural Rosette Selection reagent to each well and incubate at 37 °C for up to 1 hour.
Check cells at 20 minutes; typically collect after 30-45 minutes when rosette structures round up without disturbing surrounding cells.

steps.title: Collect Rosette Clusters
steps.instruction: Detach and collect the selected rosette clusters.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove Neural Rosette Selection reagent with a pipet without disturbing clusters.
Add 1 mL DMEM/F12 to each well.
Use a p1000 to detach rosette clusters by rinsing over them.

steps.title: Process and Centrifuge Rosettes
steps.instruction: Separate rosette material for cryopreservation or expansion and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Transfer rosette material from 1 well into a 15 mL conical tube for cryopreservation.
Transfer rosette material from 2 wells into a separate 15 mL conical tube for neural progenitor expansion.
Do not triturate clusters; leave some rosettes behind to maintain culture purity.
Centrifuge rosette clusters at 750 rpm for 3 minutes.
